text:
rachel: Quick sync — need a final narrative + two visual charts for the benchmark launch. Goal: make the latency vs cost story intuitive for PMs and inbound leads. Who can own visuals and copy this week?

devin: I can own chart frames. Thinking two visuals: (1) latency curve vs $/1k tokens for representative models, (2) throughput vs $/hour tradeoff for batch workloads. Keep slides scannable. :white_check_mark:

sam: Love that. For the narrative, can we lead with a single hero stat (e.g., typical p95 for a 512-token prompt) and then show tradeoffs? one line value + 2 bullets.

devin: Sketch for charts (quick):
```
Chart 1: x = latency (ms), y = $ / 1k tokens, lines = small/medium/large model families
Chart 2: x = throughput (reqs/s), y = $ / hour, layer = batch size (heatmap)
Annotations: call out 'predictable latency' region and 'burst cost' region
```

lee: Messaging note — avoid language like "cheapest model". Prefer: "cost-efficient", "predictable latency", "graceful degradation". Also call out Dedicated for SLA-sensitive customers.

jordan: For inbound routing we should tag leads by latency sensitivity: "real-time" (chat, search) vs "background" (vector indexing, embeddings batch). That determines CTA: Dedicated trial vs Hosted eval.

marco: Webinar flow idea: 12-min demo + 8-min benchmark walkthrough (showing the two charts live) + 20-min customer Q&A. Use 3 archetypes: chat bot, semantic search, batch embedding pipeline. Make one slide per archetype with recommended config.

rachel: Deadline = EOW for initial visuals + draft copy. @devin @sam can you pair on Figma frames? I’ll draft webinar landing copy and CTAs.

ops-bot: Reminder: design review scheduled Friday 10:00 AM PT. :bell:

devin: On it — I’ll drop mock frames in Figma (placeholder link): https://figma.com/file/xyz-demo (will update with real frames). Adding callouts for p95 and cost per 1k tokens.

rachel: Perfect. Small ask for visuals: include a one-line "what to measure" for customers (tokens/sec, p95 latency, cost per 1k tokens) and a short checklist for switching to Dedicated (SLA, isolation, throughput).

sam: Got it — will draft the one-liner + checklist and post as comments on the Figma frames.

rachel: Thanks team — will follow up with copy draft by EOD tomorrow.
